home.about.desc_1.text: Sepaktakraw is a Southeast Asian team sport that fuses volleyball with martial arts. Players use their feet, knees, chest and head to send a rattan ball over a net — a spectacular display of agility, timing and precision.

home.about.desc_2.text: The Maharashtra Sepaktakraw Association promotes this dynamic sport, develops athletes and organises competitive tournaments across the region.

home.focus_1.desc.text: Competitive events showcasing player talent and team excellence across the state.

home.focus_2.desc.text: Supporting clubs and teams in player development, logistics and coordination.

home.focus_3.desc.text: Nurturing young talent and advancing athletic capabilities at every level.

home.focus_4.desc.text: Building a thriving Sepaktakraw community across all of Maharashtra.

home.cta.subtitle.text: Explore our tournaments, teams and players to stay connected with the sport.

about.hero.subtitle.text: Promoting excellence and growth in Southeast Asian kick-volleyball sport

about.mission.text.text: To promote, develop, and advance the sport of Sepaktakraw in Maharashtra by organizing competitive tournaments, developing world-class athletes, and building a thriving community of passionate players and fans. We are committed to excellence, fair play, and the growth of the sport at all levels.

about.vision.text.text: To establish Maharashtra as a leading hub for Sepaktakraw in Asia, recognized for producing elite athletes and hosting premier international tournaments. We envision a thriving ecosystem where the sport continues to grow and inspire future generations.

about.value_1.desc.text: Pursuing the highest standards in athlete training, league administration, and team competition.

about.value_2.desc.text: Upholding honesty, respect, and fair play across all tournaments and selection trials.

about.value_3.desc.text: Building strong connections between players, regional clubs, fans, and school programs.

about.value_4.desc.text: Embracing modern coaching methodologies, facility design, and grassroots talent scouting.

about.milestone_1.desc.text: Established as the official governing body for Sepaktakraw in Maharashtra, dedicated to promoting the sport and developing local talent from grassroots levels.

about.milestone_2.desc.text: Expanded regional tournaments, supported college championships, and registered more teams across the region through active sports council coordination.

about.milestone_3.desc.text: Developed world-class athletes, established high-performance training centers in Pune, and secured competitive medal placement in National Championships.
